title: Fixed rule on net1 v4, validation: deep-long again with 64 MB TCP buffers
description: The deep-long family of exp-rule-net1v4-val-11 (rule-net1v4-val.json) again, with the same episodes (the same controllers, links, conditions and seeds), now that the guest has Sage's and ccBench's TCP buffer limits (64 MB) in place of Linux's own for a 1 GiB guest (a 4 MB send buffer), which capped buffer-filling flows on that family's longer links (docs/validation.md, "TCP buffer limits"). The other families of that run needed at most 3.5 MB in flight and are not rerun.
prepare: G="$IN/grid/$(cat "$IN/grid/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; U="-0.25 0 0.125 0.25 0.375 0.5"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v4" "$G" --u $U; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v3" "$IN/models/net1v3.pt" --u $U; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/oracle" "$IN/models/net1v3.pt" --u $U --oracle; P=(); for u in $U; do P+=(--policy "v4-u$u=$OUT/v4/rule-u$u.onnx" --policy "v3-u$u=$OUT/v3/rule-u$u.onnx" --policy "oracle-u$u=$OUT/oracle/rule-u$u-oracle.onnx"); done; RULE_EVAL_FAMILIES=deep-long:20 experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 11 11 bbr3 "${P[@]}"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --select v4 v3 oracle
